assessment: AkwaGIS requires a known Land PIN or survey plan/COD to validate, then charges ₦500 to unlock map polygons; no open anonymous vector endpoint is documented.
registryAssessment: Akwa Ibom State Government’s official AkwaGIS registry names the Ministry of Lands in Uyo and illustrates Uyo Land PINs; this confirms an official Uyo-facing registry service, while geometry access requires a paid record extract and statewide coverage is not city-bounded.

searchQueries.result: The official AkwaGIS portal says it manages the Akwa Ibom State land registry and the FAQ identifies the Ministry of Lands in Uyo. Its public land-search page shows an example Uyo Land PIN and says parcel polygons/beacons appear in paid record extracts after a free PIN/plan validation. This statewide lookup is not an anonymous open map/API and no record was searched.
